title: The in-graph workflow: a {{green:stateful LangGraph}} with gates, no interrupt()
headSub: Defined in app/workflows/workflow_graph.py. Conditional entry routes a fresh run to register_run; ADR-060 phase-2 re-enters at score_jobs on the same thread. Gates (shown between lanes) route on config + results.

lanes.transition: scoring_mode_gate (on the load_resume edge): manual -> await_scoring_selection -> END (phase 1) | relevance-filter on -> relevance_filter | else -> score_jobs
deep_review_gate: no qualifying job -> generate_report | >=1 qualifying -> deep_review
interview_router: score >= threshold (or requested) -> interview_prep | else -> generate_report

takeaway.text: State is persisted after every node, so the topology is testable independently of agent quality. The graph never blocks: the only HITL is {{blue:out of graph}}, on demand, after the run completes.
